system.name: Token-Scaled Logit Distillation (TSLD)
system.one_liner: Quantization-aware training of ternary-weight generative language models with a token-scaled logit distillation loss; this figure gives the motivation.

content.variant_note: (a) encoder row above decoder row and (b) encoder column beside decoder column, both drawn in the same grammar so only the difference remains
content.argues: Causal attention piles quantization error onto later tokens of a decoder, and a decoder gets a ground-truth loss on every token over a ~50k vocabulary, unlike an encoder.
content.subject: Attention matrices with quantization error and causal mask, and encoder versus decoder layer stacks with label and logit distributions.

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw an equation as a row of matrices with operator signs, and outline the same two tokens in two colours through the matrix and the output to show the effect; mirror the two alternatives in identical grammar so only the causal mask differs.
lessons.suits: Explaining why a mechanism behaves differently in two model families (masking, error accumulation, loss signals) with small toy matrices and toy distributions.

sections: 4 Method, quantization error in the decoder and necessity of ground-truth loss (p.4)
evidence: This illustration highlights that causal attention inherently leads to a disproportionate accumulation of quantization errors in the latter tokens.
Encoder models for NLU tasks use a single special token to compute cross-entropy loss with a limited number of classes

summary: The paper trains ternary-weight generative language models with a token-scaled logit distillation loss. Figure 1 is the motivation, not the method. Panel (a) draws attention as matrices joined by plus, times and equals: for an encoder every token collects the same quantization error, while the decoder's causal mask makes token 3 (red box) accumulate more than token 1 (blue box). Panel (b) sets an encoder, with one class-token label and a binary distribution, beside a decoder with a token-wise loss over a 50k vocabulary, on toy sentences with a wrong word in red. Flat pastel cells, thin outlines, small toy bar charts.
summary_zh: 论文为三值权重生成式语言模型提出逐词缩放的logit蒸馏。图1是动机图：(a)用矩阵等式对比编码器与解码器的量化误差，因果掩码使后面的词累积更多误差；(b)对比单标签与逐词词表级损失。
notes: The method itself (TSLD) is not drawn; the figure only motivates it. The four bitmaps in the SVG were read as the four bar charts. The role of Head in the encoder (class token only) is read from the drawing. Panel verdict 'motivation' is my own short word.
